summary.result: The system developed in this study can deal with a variety of agricultural NPS data and is expected to provide an appropriate data management tool for agricultural NPS studies.
summary.background: The objective of this research was to develop a relational database management system(RDBMS) to collect, manage and analyze data on agricultural non-point source(NPS) pollution.
summary.method: Agricultural NPS-Data Management System(ANPS-DMS) was developed using Oracle Java.
